title: GSH Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters above (the assay can handle up to 96 samples).

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download your protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (with .json extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (with .py extension) to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; tip‑rack replacement will be prompted automatically if required.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the GSH assay protocol.
